Question_text: WLT manufactures carpets. It exports 40% of its products. Globalisation has created opportunities and threats for WLT. Its method of production allows WLT to use specialisation. All of its 60 employees understand that quality assurance is important. WLT's directors are considering the best way to increase efficiency.
Sub_topic: Increasing efficiency: automation, technology, labour skills
Features, benefits, limitations: job, batch, flow production

Parts.part_text: Define 'specialisation'.
Identify two methods of production.
Outline two advantages to WLT of using quality assurance.
Explain one opportunity and one threat of globalisation for WLT.
Do you think improving labour skills is the best way for a manufacturing business to increase efficiency? Justify your answer.

Question_text: LMA is a family-owned restaurant. The business was started 20 years ago and has remained small. LMA is a partnership. The partners are considering whether LMA should become a private limited company. The Finance Manager is analysing LMA's cash-flow forecast. An extract is shown in Table 2.1.
image: Table 2.1 is an extract from LMA's cash-flow forecast for 2023, in thousands of dollars. It shows cash inflow, cash outflow, net cash flow, opening balance, and closing balance for July, August, and September. Some values are given, and 'X' and 'Y' are placeholders for calculation.
Sub_topic: What is cash-flow forecast, construction, importance
Overcome short-term problems: overdraft, delay payments, quicker debtor payments
Features: sole traders, partnerships, private/public limited companies, franchises, joint ventures

Parts.part_text: Identify two reasons why a business might have cash-flow problems.
Calculate X and Y.
Identify four examples of a cash inflow.
Explain one advantage and one disadvantage to LMA of becoming a private limited company.
Explain two reasons why a business might remain small. Which reason is likely to be most important? Justify your answer.

Question_text: DZD is a large parcel delivery business. Many of its employees work part-time. DZD's directors are planning to expand the business and have to decide on a suitable source of finance for 20 new vehicles. DZD will also recruit 60 new employees. The Human Resources Director is preparing a job description for the new employees. She is considering using Maslow's hierarchy of needs to increase the motivation of DZD's employees.
Topic: 2.3 Recruitment, selection and training of employees
Sub_topic: Concept of human needs, Maslow’s hierarchy
Benefits, limitations: part-time vs full-time employees
Reasons for finance: start-up, expansion, working capital
Factors in choice: size, legal form, amount, time, loans

Parts.part_text: Define 'job description'.
Identify two levels from Maslow's hierarchy of needs.
Outline two factors DZD should consider when deciding which applicants to recruit.
Explain two sources of finance DZD might use for the new vehicles.
Do you think a service business should only employ part-time workers? Justify your answer.

Question_text: NLR manufactures a range of branded skincare products including hand cream. Packaging of the products is important. Like many businesses, NLR makes use of market segmentation. The Marketing Director knows the stage of the product life cycle can influence NLR's pricing decisions. He is analysing market research data. This shows 85% of consumers expect businesses to respond to environmental pressures.
Sub_topic: Brand image: impact on sales, loyalty
How/why segment: age, socio-economic, location, gender
Product life cycle: stages, extension strategies
Pricing methods: cost plus, competitive, penetration, skimming, promotional
Business impact on environment: global warming

Parts.part_text: Identify two factors that might affect the accuracy of market research.
Identify two benefits to a business of using market segmentation.
Outline two ways NLR might respond to environmental pressures.
Explain how NLR's pricing decisions might be affected at two different stages of the product life cycle.
Do you think promoting the brand image is the most important role of packaging? Justify your answer.
